purpose: Teach: 連合/入手/出場/総務/プレス/出荷/故障/名義

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、連合、絶対、参加、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: We should commit fully to joining the industry alliance.
lines.style: Direct and purposeful. Crisp attack on the opening. Steady pace, no hesitation. This is a decision, not a suggestion. Clear, professional register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新型機器の、本気で、絶対、入手、絶対、進んでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making solid progress on acquiring the new equipment.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Warm undertone of competence. Steady pacing with a slight emphasis on progress. Professional but not stiff. The voice of someone reporting what he's handled.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、コンペ、絶対、当社、絶対、出場、絶対、決まりましたね
lines.en: It's settled—our company will enter the industry competition.
lines.style: Affirming. Clean attack on the opening. Slight emphasis on 'settled' to mark the finality. Engaged pace, forward momentum. The tone of someone guiding others past doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。総務、絶対、部、絶対、ご担当者、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll introduce you to the person from General Affairs who can help.
lines.style: Helpful and businesslike. Light emphasis on 'introduce' — this is his offering. Warm underneath the professionalism. No rush, but clear. The reliability of a colleague making good on a promise.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレス、絶対、対応、絶対、当社、絶対、慎重にいきましょう
lines.en: For the press response, let's keep our company's approach careful and measured.
lines.style: Directive but not demanding. Slight weight on 'careful' — this matters. Moderate pace. The tone of someone thinking ahead about what could go wrong and preventing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、出荷、絶対、計画通り、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The new product shipment is moving forward exactly as planned.
lines.style: Steady confidence. Emphasis on 'exactly as planned'—this is controlled and on track. Even pacing. Professional satisfaction without smugness. The voice of someone who's handled the details.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、故障、絶対、対応、絶対、サポート、絶対、強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen our support systems for handling equipment issues.
lines.style: Purposeful and forward-looking. Clear attack on the opening. Moderate pace with slight emphasis on 'strengthen.' This is improvement, not crisis. The tone of someone thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引先の、本気で、絶対、名義、絶対、確認、絶対、終えました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've finished verifying all the details with our new business partners.
lines.style: Complete and satisfied. Light emphasis on 'finished' — a task closed. Even, professional pace. Warmth of closure. The voice of someone who's wrapped up what matters.
